title: Payment-Size Schedule for the Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility Prompt-Pay Rate
content:
Payment-size points are added to the prompt-pay rate of an Insurance Coverage & Patient Responsibility account according to the amount the qualifying payment paid on the charge, read from that patient-payment entry.

| Amount the qualifying payment paid | Points added |
|---|---|
| at least 250.00 | 1 |
| at least 50.00 but less than 250.00 | 0.5 |
| less than 50.00 | 0 |

The points are added to the prompt-pay rate itself, which is applied once; they are not applied as a discount of their own.

Boundary amounts (hypothetical): 250.00 adds 1; 249.99 adds 0.5; 50.00 adds 0.5; 49.99 adds none.
